items.title: CNN, MS NOW and Politico are turned away from the White House
items.summary: A day after Trump said he was banning CNN, MS NOW and Politico, their journalists were stopped at the White House gate and reported from the sidewalk. Bernie Sanders warned the Times and Post could be next.
items.author: @BernieSanders

post.name: Bernie Sanders
post.text:
Trump has now banned CNN, MS NOW and POLITICO from entering the White House grounds.
